Package com.smu.mtc.mtcbean

Interface DaoSupport

All Known Implementing Classes:
MTC_Data_Dao_MySQL, MTC_Data_Dao_SQLite, MTC_Data_Dao_SQLite, MTC_Data_Dao_SQLite_Common
public interface DaoSupport
Optional transaction boundary for database adapters that need an entire MTC build round to be atomic.

Implement this interface together with the selected MTC_Data_Dao specialization when using a transactional database. The reference JdbiTransactionSupport helper shows one way to bind all JDBI DAO calls to the same connection and transaction.

  • Method Details

    • inTransaction

      <T> T inTransaction(DaoSupport.TxAction<T> action) throws Exception
      Executes action as a single atomic database transaction. Every MTC_Data_Dao call made (directly or indirectly, e.g. via MTC_Service_AppendOnly.build(java.util.ArrayList<com.smu.mtc.mtcbean.MTC_Cert_Record>, long)) from within action on this same instance participates in that one transaction; if action throws, all of its writes are rolled back.

      This matters once the DAO is backed by a networked database (e.g. MySQL): build() performs several dependent writes (node updates, cert inserts, node inserts, state insert) that must land together or not at all, otherwise a mid-batch failure (network blip, crash) can leave the state chain half-built.

      Type Parameters:
      T - the result type produced by action.
      Parameters:
      action - the unit of work to run inside the transaction.
      Returns:
      whatever action returns.
      Throws:
      Exception - if action throws, or the transaction itself fails to commit.
